Pairs plot of mvgam parameters

Source: R/pairs.mvgam.R
pairs.mvgam.Rd

Scatters the posterior draws of each pair of parameters, with each parameter's marginal posterior on the diagonal, as bayesplot::mcmc_pairs() draws them. Divergent transitions are marked. A ridge or a funnel between two parameters shows that the data separate them poorly.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam'
pairs(x, variable = NULL, regex = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted mvgam or jsdgam object

variable

Names of the variables (parameters) to plot, as given by a character vector or a regular expression (if regex = TRUE). By default, a hopefully not too large selection of variables is plotted.

regex

Logical; Indicates whether variable should be treated as regular expressions. Defaults to FALSE.

...

Further arguments to bayesplot::mcmc_pairs(), such as off_diag_args.

Value

A bayesplot_grid object

Details

Without variable, the plot shows the parameters mcmc_plot.mvgam() shows: the population coefficients, the family parameters, the variance components and the trend's dynamics and loadings. The per-basis smooth coefficients (s_*) and the group-level deviations (r_*) run to hundreds on a spline or hierarchical fit. They are drawn when variable names them.

See also

mcmc_plot.mvgam() draws the other bayesplot MCMC plots. mvgam_draws lists the shortcuts variable accepts.

Other posterior summaries: VarCorr.mvgam(), bibtex(), how_to_cite.mvgam(), hypothesis.mvgam(), index-mvgam, mcmc_plot.mvgam(), methods_md(), mvgam_draws, posterior_interval.mvgam(), ranef.mvgam(), smooths.mvgam(), summary.mvgam()

Examples

# \dontrun{
set.seed(13)
simdat <- sim_mvgam(family = poisson(), n_series = 1L,
                     n_timepoints = 120L, trend_model = AR())
mod <- mvgam(y ~ s(x), trend_formula = ~ AR(p = 1),
              data    = simdat$data_train,
              family  = poisson(),
              chains  = 2, silent = 2)
#> Warning: 9 of 2000 (0.0%) transitions ended with a divergence.
#> See https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings for details.

# The trend's autoregression against its innovation scale
pairs(mod, variable = "trend_params")


# Next, mcmc_plot(mod, type = "rank_overlay") checks that the chains
# mix
# }
